global involvement
We encourage employee volunteerism around the world. In Latin America, the Texaco Regional Youth Development program works with Chevron volunteers to conduct after-school programs, motivate students to stay in school, organize sports tournaments, and help with school improvement projects such as small repairs, cleaning and painting. The program has reached nearly 25,000 students in El Salvador, Honduras, Guatemala and Panama.
global involvement
view image
employee commitment
Chevron is committed to supporting employees, retirees, contractors, and their families and friends in their efforts to strengthen their communities through hands-on volunteerism. In 2015, the 22nd annual Chevron Volunteer Week was held in the San Francisco Bay Area, and nearly 2,200 Chevron employees, friends and family participated in volunteer activities for 100 local nonprofit organizations to complete 220 projects.
employee commitment
view image
local partnerships
By partnering with local communities and nonprofit organizations, we can amplify our positive impact in the communities where we operate. The Houston Food Bank is one of the many community organizations we partner with. During the 2015 Chevron Houston Humankind Campaign, more than 1,500 Chevron volunteers helped sort and package more than 445,000 pounds of food – equating to nearly 362,000 nutritious meals for people in need.

Top:
Twice a year, Chevron Richmond employees conduct mock interviews with Contra Costa County ROP students. In 2016, 73 employees and 130 ROP students participated in the mock interviews, and employees contributed 803 hours to the program.
Left:
Since 1997, more than 3,400 Chevron Houston employees have volunteered 95,000 hours with Habitat Humanity. Through the partnership, Chevron has contributed $2.83 million in home sponsorships and Chevron Humankind employee donations.

learn more about the chevron way
volunteering
around the world
In countries around the world, Chevron employees are applying their skills, experience and energy in volunteer activities that help improve education, provide basic needs, foster new business opportunities and ultimately strengthen the communities in which we operate.
Chevron has a long history of support for cleft lip and palate surgeries in Venezuela in partnership with Operation Smile Foundation and other institutions. Since 1998, more than 3,000 patients have been seen, and our employee volunteers have provided valuable support by helping patients with medical forms and assisting with interpretations.
Chevron volunteers in Aberdeen, Scotland participate in the Engineers 'n’ Our Lives initiative, which enables students to demonstrate STEM skills in real-life settings. More than 10,000 schoolchildren have taken part in the program, giving them the opportunity to appreciate the role engineering plays in their lives.
Chevron Thailand partnered with the Institute of Sufficiency Economy and the Agri-Nature Foundation to initiate “The Power of Human Energy: A Journey Inspired by the King” project in 2013. Since then, over 2,000 Chevron Thailand volunteers have helped build earthen dikes, dig irrigation ponds, build check dams and plant trees.
chevron
humankind
Through Chevron Humankind, employees, retirees and contractors in the United States provide support for their communities throughout the year.
For World AIDS Day 2017, 145 employees in San Ramon assembled 5,700 personal hygiene kits that are being distributed to clients of the San Francisco AIDS Foundation and Cal-PEP.
Each month, Salt Lake Refinery employees volunteer at a mobile food pantry that provides food to nearly 100 families at a neighboring elementary school.
In cooperation with the Freeport-McMoRan Audubon Species Survival Center, Chevron volunteers in Louisiana are helping to breed, hatch, and rear whooping crane chicks to supplement the wild population. In 2017, Chevron volunteers spent 146 hours to help keep the habitat sustainable for breeding programs.

culture
our employees put values into action
We’re a global team united by a shared set of values, called The Chevron Way. From our volunteering initiatives to our commitment to diversity and inclusion, you’ll see that our values are so much more than words on a screen – they’re our way of life.
learn more about the chevron way
volunteering
around the world
In countries around the world, Chevron employees are applying their skills, experience and energy in volunteer activities that help improve education, provide basic needs, foster new business opportunities and ultimately strengthen the communities in which we operate.
Chevron’s Anar Aitekenova is pictured conducting a cooking class at Almaty orphanage in Kazakhstan.
Members of Chevron Knitting Club presented almost 100 warm vests, hats and scarves to children from the Almaty orphanage.
Tengizchevroil employees and their families joined the campaign ‘Plant a tree,’ organized by the Yntymak Volunteer Organization, at the Speech Impaired School in Atyrau, Kazakhstan.
Sightings of olive ridley sea turtles were reported soon after 300 Chevron volunteers and residents held the 10th annual coastal clean-up along the terminal coastline in San Pascual, Batangas, in the Philippines. About 2.4 tons of litter was cleared from the beach.
In October 2018, the International Products’ leadership team visited local food charity, Food from the Heart. A total of 19 volunteers dedicated their time to packing 183 food packs that were sent to families and schoolchildren across Singapore.
The XYZ Network Singapore recorded 60 volunteer hours to help 97 direct beneficiaries learn basic circuitry to build robotic insects. Conducted in partnership with Science Centre Singapore, the event created awareness of Chevron Singapore’s signature social investment, Caltex Fuel Your School.
As part of their team-building efforts, the International Products’ Legal team of 29 volunteers contributed 101.5 volunteer hours to Willing Hearts, a soup kitchen that provides meals to some 5,000 Singaporeans in need.
Chevron employees contributed their time to tree planting and beautification of the landscape of Orphanage #10 in Almaty.
Chevron volunteers are seen digging an irrigation canal to prevent flood as part of We Volunteer in Thailand.
Indonesia Business Unit (IBU) dispatched two medical officers, Dr. Rahmat and Nurse Mike to Palu, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia to join an earthquake emergency response team. The team was coordinated by SKK Migas, an industry regulator, to support local health authorities in providing medical services to the affected community.
chevron
humankind
Through Chevron Humankind, employees, retirees and contractors in the United States provide support for their communities throughout the year.
Over 180 Chevron volunteers work with Trees For Houston every year on the signature “Let’s Grow” event, solidifying a relationship that began 25 years ago. Our volunteers prepared the trees for planting in public spaces throughout greater Houston. Over the life of our partnership, Chevron has planted more than 225,000 trees.
Chevron Executive Women’s Group and San Ramon volunteers engaged female students from an Oakland, CA middle school in STEM activities. This event is part of our STEM initiative with Techbridge Girls, a partnership which began in 2009. The fieldtrip involved learning opportunities including a hands-on biofuels experience.
Chevron Chairman and CEO Mike Wirth joined over 200 employees to sort and package food at the Houston Food Bank. Employees spent more than 550 volunteer hours during the event. Throughout 2018, a total of 1,800 volunteers attended 66 volunteering events at the Houston Food Bank totaling 6,960 volunteer hours.
Chevron volunteers worked to fill 250 backpacks for local at-risk youth in need of supplies for the 2018-19 school year. The Northshore Food Bank in Covington, Louisiana, provides food assistance to more than 375 individuals and families each week who live at or below the poverty threshold.
